title: PRIPYAT
sub: वो शहर जो कभी नहीं लौटा
en: A city of 50,000 people emptied in a single afternoon.
Pripyat. The town of the Chernobyl plant's workers.
It had schools, a cinema, and a swimming pool.
On May 1st, a new Ferris wheel was due to open here.
But on April 26th, the reactor exploded.
Thirty-six hours later, the buses came. People were told: just three days.
Clothes, toys, books. Everything was left behind.
Today the forest is slowly swallowing the city.
And that Ferris wheel has never turned to this day.
